goal: Produce a faithful, concise summary of the material provided in the user's request.
rationale: Parsimony is the design point: a single llm_call is the right shape for summarization. The router routes here precisely because summarization requires no fan-out, no retrieval, and no multi-step reasoning — one node with a precise instruction demonstrates the authored baseline.

params.instruction: Summarize the material in the following request faithfully and concisely; preserve key numbers, names, and caveats; output only the summary. Request: {prompt}

metadata.purpose: Arm B router library — summarize task type
